tasks.subject: Task 1: Cosmian helper scripts, verified locally end-to-end
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create `ci/install-cosmian.sh` and `ci/start-cosmian.sh` and prove the full integration test suite passes against a locally running Cosmian KMS.

**Files:**
- Create: `ci/install-cosmian.sh`
- Create: `ci/start-cosmian.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `ci/start-cosmian.sh /tmp/cosmian-run` starts a Cosmian server (binary from `COSMIAN_KMS_BIN`), becomes ready within 15 s, and prints `export KMIP_*` lines
- [ ] Full local ctest run (gcc, Release, `BUILD_TESTS=ON`, `BUILD_KMIP_TESTS=ON`) passes with those env vars
- [ ] `grep -F '[  SKIPPED ]' build-ci-check/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log` finds nothing (zero skipped tests, including the KMIP 2.0 suite enabled via `KMIP_RUN_2_0_TESTS=1`)
- [ ] Both scripts committed executable (mode 100755)

**Verify:** `ci/start-cosmian.sh /tmp/cosmian-run > /tmp/cosmian-env.sh && source /tmp/cosmian-env.sh && ctest --test-dir build-ci-check --output-on-failure` -> `100% tests passed`; skip-grep returns nothing.

**Steps:** Full script contents and exact commands in plan Task 1 (Steps 1-8). If any integration test fails against Cosmian, STOP and report to the user.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["ci/install-cosmian.sh", "ci/start-cosmian.sh"], "verifyCommand": "ci/start-cosmian.sh /tmp/cosmian-run > /tmp/cosmian-env.sh && source /tmp/cosmian-env.sh && ctest --test-dir build-ci-check --output-on-failure && ! grep -F '[  SKIPPED ]' build-ci-check/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log", "acceptanceCriteria": ["start-cosmian.sh starts server ready within 15s and emits KMIP_* exports", "full ctest passes against local Cosmian", "zero skipped tests in LastTest.log", "scripts committed with mode 100755"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Reformat kmipcore/kmipclient and add ci/check-format.sh
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make the new C++ libraries clean under pinned clang-format 18.1.8 and add the reusable check script, so the CI format job starts green.

**Files:**
- Create: `ci/check-format.sh`
- Modify: ~30 files under `kmipcore/` and `kmipclient/` (mechanical `clang-format -i`, no manual edits)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `ci/check-format.sh` exits 0 with clang-format 18.1.8 on PATH
- [ ] Reformat commit contains ONLY formatting changes produced by `clang-format -i`
- [ ] Project still builds and server-independent tests pass after reformatting
- [ ] `ci/check-format.sh` committed executable (mode 100755)

**Verify:** `PATH="/tmp/cf18-venv/bin:$PATH" ci/check-format.sh && echo CLEAN` -> `CLEAN`; then `ctest --test-dir build-ci-check --output-on-failure -E '^KmipClient'` -> all pass.

**Steps:** Full script content and exact commands in plan Task 2 (Steps 1-6).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["ci/check-format.sh", "kmipcore/", "kmipclient/"], "verifyCommand": "PATH=/tmp/cf18-venv/bin:$PATH ci/check-format.sh && ctest --test-dir build-ci-check --output-on-failure -E '^KmipClient'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["check-format.sh exits 0 under clang-format 18.1.8", "reformat commit is formatting-only", "build and server-independent tests pass", "script mode 100755"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The single workflow with the build-test matrix, format job, and docs job, triggered on master pushes and PRs.

**Files:**
- Create: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Triggers: `push` to `master`, `pull_request` (no branch filter), concurrency group cancels superseded runs
- [ ] `build-test`: 4-cell matrix (gcc/clang x Release/ASAN), `fail-fast: false`, Cosmian .deb cached, test step fails on any `[  SKIPPED ]`, failure artifacts uploaded
- [ ] `format`: `pipx install clang-format==18.1.8` + `ci/check-format.sh`
- [ ] `docs`: doxygen + graphviz, `cmake -DBUILD_DOCS=ON` + `--target doc`
- [ ] YAML parses with python yaml.safe_load

**Verify:** `/tmp/cf18-venv/bin/python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml'))" && echo OK` -> `OK`.

**Steps:** Complete workflow YAML is in plan Task 3 Step 1 — use verbatim, parse-check, commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/ci.yml"], "verifyCommand": "/tmp/cf18-venv/bin/python3 -c \"import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml'))\" && echo OK", "acceptanceCriteria": ["push-to-master and pull_request triggers with concurrency group", "4-cell build-test matrix with cosmian cache, skip-guard, failure artifacts", "format job with pinned clang-format 18.1.8", "docs job builds doc target", "YAML parses"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Push to fork and validate both CI triggers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the CI behaves correctly on GitHub: the push-triggered run goes green across all six jobs, and a pull request also triggers the workflow.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- None (push + observation only)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `master` pushed to fork remote `dutow` — NOT `origin` (upstream Percona-Lab)
- [ ] Push-triggered workflow run for the pushed HEAD SHA completes with conclusion `success` (all 6 jobs), confirmed via GitHub API
- [ ] A pull request on the fork triggers the workflow (a run with event `pull_request` exists)

**Verify:** `curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/dutow/libkmip/actions/runs?head_sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" | python3 -c "import json,sys; rs=json.load(sys.stdin)['workflow_runs']; print([(r['event'], r['status'], r['conclusion']) for r in rs])"` -> contains `('push', 'completed', 'success')`.

**Steps:** Plan Task 4 (Steps 1-4): push, poll API, diagnose/fix/re-push on failure (Doxyfile INPUT trailing-comment watch item), validate PR trigger, capture evidence.
